description: This file declares the AttachSource class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for attaching media sources in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes method declarations for executing the task, adding, updating, and switching sources, as well as creating media caps and audio attributes. The class manages references to various wrappers and context objects necessary for media source attachment.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: A class responsible for attaching media sources to the player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: AttachSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AttachSource task with necessary context, wrappers, player, and media source.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source to the player, given media caps and DRM status.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the existing media source with new caps or configuration.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Switches the audio source based on media caps.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object from the current media source.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Creates audio attributes for the media source.
